meta.name: analytics-tracking
meta.description: Set up, audit, and debug analytics tracking implementation — GA4, Google Tag Manager, event taxonomy, conversion tracking, and data quality. Use when building a tracking plan from scratch, auditing existing analytics for gaps or errors, debugging missing events, or setting up GTM. Trigger keywords: GA4 setup, Google Tag Manager, GTM, event tracking, analytics implementation, conversion tracking, tracking plan, event taxonomy, custom dimensions, UTM tracking, analytics audit, missing events, tracking broken. NOT for analyzing marketing campaign data — use campaign-analytics for that. NOT for BI dashboards — use product-analytics for in-product event analysis.

copy.tagline: 搭建、审计和调试网站分析追踪方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要搭建或排查网站分析追踪（GA4/GTM）
copy.tagline_en: Set up, audit, and debug analytics tracking implementations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up or troubleshoot analytics tracking (GA4/GTM)

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你搭建、审计和调试网站分析追踪系统，包括 GA4、Google Tag Manager、事件分类、转化追踪和数据质量检查。它会生成追踪计划、检查现有设置的问题，并给出修复步骤。
howto.when: 当你提到“GA4 设置”、“Google Tag Manager”、“事件追踪”、“转化追踪”、“追踪计划”、“分析审计”等关键词，或要求搭建、审计、调试分析追踪时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭建一个 GA4 和 GTM 的追踪计划。
say.note: Claude 会生成事件分类表和配置清单。

say.text: 审计我现有的分析追踪，找出缺失的事件。
say.note: Claude 会进行差距分析并给出修复优先级。

say.text: 调试一下转化追踪，数据对不上。
say.note: Claude 会提供结构化调试步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you set up, audit, and debug analytics tracking systems including GA4, Google Tag Manager, event taxonomy, conversion tracking, and data quality. It generates tracking plans, checks existing setups for issues, and provides fix steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "GA4 setup", "Google Tag Manager", "event tracking", "conversion tracking", "tracking plan", "analytics audit", or ask to build, audit, or debug analytics tracking.

say_en.text: Help me build a tracking plan for GA4 and GTM.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an event taxonomy table and configuration checklist.

say_en.text: Audit my existing analytics tracking for missing events.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a gap analysis and prioritize fixes.

say_en.text: Debug conversion tracking, numbers don't match.
say_en.note: Claude will provide structured debugging steps.
